title: The Debt of Tashkent
author: V. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
